title: The Dark Truth About Treehouse of Horror XXXIII #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Treehouse of Horror XXXIII shows exactly where that breaks. "Treehouse of Horror XXXIII" is the sixth episode of the thirty-fourth season of the American animated television series The Simpsons, and the 734th episode overall. This is the 33rd Treehouse of Horror episode, and, like the other Treehouse of Horror episodes, consists of three self-contained segments: "The Pookadook" (a parody of The Babadook), "Death Tome" (a parody of Death Note), and "Simpsons World" (a parody of Westworld).

What looks like free choice in Treehouse of Horror XXXIII is older than choice itself. The highlight of the episode has to be 'Simpsonsworld', which brought back many fan-favorite moments in an epic Westworld style. The episode won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Animated Program at the 75th Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Awards.
